description: Bounded publication case for current-source-certified Bajaj reinstatement claim-sequence usability.

decision_reasons: The bounded claim-sequence certification passes through the generic eligibility-and-consequence topic.
Direct source assertions are anchored to current Bajaj policy wording SHA 05dc291324340d5293f9f5f430f44b14e3da34052d6357455714af2dfa499158.
The triggering-claim ineligibility consequence is a governed derivation from subsequent-claim-only utilization semantics and is not represented as literal policy wording.
Unresolved restoration activation, amount, illness-scope, and bonus mechanics remain explicit limitations.

authoritative_publication.publication_authority: Phase 2 governed authoritative bounded-state-mechanic publication authority

guardrails: This publication is limited to claim-sequence usability of reinstated Sum Insured.
It does not publish the exact activation trigger, restored amount, same-illness scope, different-illness rule, or bonus interaction.
It does not infer positive later-claim entitlement while the activation trigger remains unresolved.
It does not establish claim admissibility, claim payment, arbitrary restoration evaluation, or cross-insurer restoration generalization.
The triggering-claim consequence must remain marked DERIVED with its evaluator derivation reference.
